mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_request (requester_id, addressee_id, message, status) VALUES (#{requesterId}, #{addresseeId}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_request SET status = 0, message = #{message}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (2, 3)
mapper.select: SELECT id, requester_id AS requesterId, addressee_id AS addresseeId, message, status, created_time AS createdTime, updated_time AS updatedTime FROM friend_request WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, requester_id AS requesterId, addressee_id AS addresseeId, message, status, created_time AS createdTime, updated_time AS updatedTime FROM friend_request WHERE requester_id = #{requesterId} AND addressee_id = #{addresseeId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, requester_id AS requesterId, addressee_id AS addresseeId, message, status, created_time AS createdTime, updated_time AS updatedTime FROM friend_request WHERE status = 0 AND ((requester_id = #{userIdA} AND addressee_id = #{userIdB}) OR (requester_id = #{userIdB} AND addressee_id = #{userIdA})) LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.requester_id AS requesterId, COALESCE(ru.nickname, ru.username) AS requesterName, ru.avatar AS requesterAvatar, r.addressee_id AS addresseeId, COALESCE(au.nickname, au.username) AS addresseeName, au.avatar AS addresseeAvatar, r.message, r.status, r.created_time AS createdTime FROM friend_request r INNER JOIN user ru ON ru.id = r.requester_id AND ru.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN user au ON au.id = r.addressee_id AND au.deleted = 0
mapper.select: WHERE r.addressee_id = #{addresseeId} AND r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.created_time DESC
WHERE r.requester_id = #{requesterId} AND r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.created_time DESC
